sources.title: Owner supplied Peñafrancia cemetery comparison
sources.note: Owner annotated ASCII placement correction, inspected 2026-10-02. Image/capture date unknown. Positions, dimensions and heights are draft estimates; no historical dates or surveyed inventory inferred. Reference bitmaps are not shipped. Dense raised tomb/crypt rows and low slab roofs replace the misleading uninterrupted lawn appearance. Row axes follow mapped internal access; source road clearances interrupt rows. Counts represent geometry, not individual burials. No deceased names or inferred historical dates.
